name: OriginalSourceCollection
description: Holds original source data as it arrived, before anyone decided what it means. Capture never transforms and nothing is ever destroyed: DISCARDED is how you say ignore this, and there is no delete. Sources are resolved by namespaced identifier rather than by position, so re-running a backfill updates what it already captured instead of duplicating it, and a second sighting of the same object under a different id lands on the record that already exists. Companion to the Original Source Queue: the queue names the slices that failed, the collection holds what the rest produced.

global.schema:
"""
Where a source, or a whole collection, stands.
- NEW: captured, untouched.
- PROCESSING: someone or something is working on it.
- COMPLETED: done with.
- DISCARDED: deliberately ignored, or folded into another source. Never
  deleted: an original-source store that can forget is not one.
"""
enum OriginalSourceStatus {
    NEW
    PROCESSING
    COMPLETED
    DISCARDED
}

enum ProcessingTaskStatus {
    DRAFT
    TODO
    IN_PROGRESS
    DONE
    CANCELLED
}

"""
Where this collection's contents came from, as a whole.
"""
type OSCProvenance {
    """
    The Original Source Queue that drove the capture, when one did. This is
    what lets the two documents be read together: the queue names the slices
    that failed, the collection holds what the rest produced. Neither answers
    is this backfill complete on its own.
    """
    queue: PHID
    """A short name for the source system: gmail, toggl, filesystem."""
    system: String
    """Anything else worth recording about the run, verbatim."""
    detail: Unknown
}

"""
A file in the attachment store.

Only the ref and a name are required. A piece that wrote the file through
context.files.write gets back a ref and usually a name, but not always a mime
type or a size; demanding fields the source does not supply would force a
flow to invent them, and an invented mime type is worse than an absent one.

Recording the ref here is also what makes the file readable: the attachment
port refuses a download unless the document references it.
"""
type OSCAttachment {
    ref: AttachmentRef!
    fileName: String!
    sizeBytes: Int
    mimeType: String
}

"""
One thing that was captured.
"""
type OriginalSource {
    id: OID!
    status: OriginalSourceStatus!

    """
    Canonical identifier, namespaced by its system: gmail:18f3a, sha256:9de1.
    The namespace is required, because without it an id from one system and
    an id from another are the same key.
    """
    externalId: String!
    """
    Every other identifier this object is known by, same shape. Capture
    matches on these too, which is how a second sighting under a different id
    lands on the record that already exists. No identifier belongs to more
    than one source.
    """
    aliases: [String!]!

    title: String
    origin: URL
    """Human-readable text, when the source has any."""
    content: String
    """The record exactly as received, untouched. The reason this model exists."""
    payload: Unknown

    attachments: [OSCAttachment!]!
    references: [URL!]!
    tags: [String!]!

    """When the thing happened at the source."""
    occurredAt: DateTime
    """
    When this object first entered the collection. It never moves: a merge
    keeps the earliest sighting, so letting a re-capture push this forward
    would make a long-known source lose a merge it should win.

    A different question from occurredAt, and both are needed: a 2019 email
    captured today is dated 2019 for analysis and today for what did this run
    pick up.
    """
    capturedAt: DateTime!
    """The most recent sighting. Equals capturedAt until it is seen again."""
    lastSeenAt: DateTime!

    """
    Set when this source was folded into another. Its payload and attachments
    stay here; only the identity moved.
    """
    mergedInto: OID
    mergedAt: DateTime
    """Calculated: the sources folded into this one, so the trail is walkable both ways."""
    mergedFrom: [OID!]!
}

type ProcessingTask {
    id: OID!
    status: ProcessingTaskStatus!
    owner: String
    description: String
    """The source this is about. Absent means it is about the batch."""
    source: OID
    createdAt: DateTime!
}

"""Calculated. What a person wants to know without counting a list."""
type OSCCounts {
    total: Int!
    new: Int!
    processing: Int!
    completed: Int!
    discarded: Int!
    merged: Int!
    openTasks: Int!
}

type OriginalSourceCollectionState {
    title: String
    description: String
    provenance: OSCProvenance

    sources: [OriginalSource!]!
    tasks: [ProcessingTask!]!

    """
    Calculated from the sources, except DISCARDED which is set: abandoning a
    whole collection is a decision, not a roll-up.
    """
    status: OriginalSourceStatus!
    counts: OSCCounts!
}

modules.name: collection
modules.description: The collection itself: what it is called, where it came from, and whether it is still live.

operations.name: SET_TITLE
operations.description: Title the collection. Named SET_TITLE rather than SET_NAME because SET_NAME is a reserved base action — a model defining it would silently override the document's own rename.
operations.template: Title the collection. Named SET_TITLE rather than SET_NAME because SET_NAME is a reserved base action — a model defining it would silently override the document's own rename.
operations.reducer: state.title = action.input.title ?? null;

operations.name: SET_DESCRIPTION
operations.description: Describe what this collection holds.
operations.template: Describe what this collection holds.
operations.reducer: state.description = action.input.description ?? null;

operations.name: SET_PROVENANCE
operations.description: Record where the contents came from, and the queue that drove the capture.
operations.template: Record where the contents came from, and the queue that drove the capture.

operations.name: DISCARD_COLLECTION
operations.description: Abandon the whole collection. Nothing is deleted; capture into it is refused until it is restored.
operations.template: Abandon the whole collection. Nothing is deleted; capture into it is refused until it is restored.

errors.name: CollectionAlreadyDiscardedError
errors.description: This collection has already been abandoned.

operations.name: RESTORE_COLLECTION
operations.description: Undo a discard. The status goes back to being calculated from the sources.
operations.template: Undo a discard. The status goes back to being calculated from the sources.

errors.name: CollectionNotDiscardedError
errors.description: This collection is live, so there is nothing to restore. Its status is calculated from its sources.

modules.name: capture
modules.description: Taking things in, exactly as they arrived. Nothing here transforms a payload.

operations.name: CAPTURE_SOURCE
operations.description: Take one record in, exactly as it arrived. Resolved by identifier, not by position: an unknown identifier creates a source, a known one updates it in place, and identifiers spanning several existing sources fold them together. This is what makes re-running a backfill safe.
operations.schema:
input CapturedAttachmentInput {
    ref: AttachmentRef!
    fileName: String!
    sizeBytes: Int
    mimeType: String
}

input CaptureSourceInput {
    """Used only when this capture creates a source; reducers cannot generate ids."""
    id: OID!
    externalId: String!
    aliases: [String!]
    title: String
    origin: URL
    content: String
    payload: Unknown
    attachments: [CapturedAttachmentInput!]
    references: [URL!]
    tags: [String!]
    occurredAt: DateTime
    """
    When this sighting happened. Becomes capturedAt on a new source and
    lastSeenAt on every sighting, including the first.
    """
    capturedAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Take one record in, exactly as it arrived. Resolved by identifier, not by position: an unknown identifier creates a source, a known one updates it in place, and identifiers spanning several existing sources fold them together. This is what makes re-running a backfill safe.

errors.name: CaptureIntoDiscardedCollectionError
errors.description: This collection has been abandoned, so capturing into it would quietly add to something nobody is reading. Restore it first.

errors.name: CaptureUnnamespacedIdentifierError
errors.description: Every identifier must carry the system it came from, as system:value. Without it, an id from Gmail and an id from Toggl are the same key, and two unrelated objects would be treated as one.

errors.name: CaptureSourceIdTakenError
errors.description: No existing source claims these identifiers, so this capture would create one — but the OID given already belongs to a different source. Supply a fresh id.

operations.name: ATTACH_TO_SOURCE
operations.description: Add a file to a source after the fact. The ref must reach the document before its bytes can be downloaded, because the attachment port refuses a read the document does not reference.
operations.schema:
input AttachToSourceInput {
    source: OID!
    ref: AttachmentRef!
    fileName: String!
    sizeBytes: Int
    mimeType: String
}
operations.template: Add a file to a source after the fact. The ref must reach the document before its bytes can be downloaded, because the attachment port refuses a read the document does not reference.

errors.name: AttachSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id to attach to.

errors.name: AttachRefAlreadyPresentError
errors.description: That file is already attached to this source. Attachments are content-addressed, so the same ref twice is the same bytes twice.

operations.name: DETACH_FROM_SOURCE
operations.description: Remove a file reference from a source, for one attached in error. The bytes stay in the store.
operations.template: Remove a file reference from a source, for one attached in error. The bytes stay in the store.

errors.name: DetachSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

errors.name: DetachRefNotFoundError
errors.description: That file is not attached to this source.

operations.name: ADD_SOURCE_REFERENCE
operations.description: Point a source at something related elsewhere.
operations.template: Point a source at something related elsewhere.

errors.name: ReferenceSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

modules.name: identity
modules.description: Working out which captures are the same object, and folding them together without losing either.

operations.name: ADD_ALIAS
operations.description: Tell a source it is also known by this identifier, so a later capture under it lands here.
operations.template: Tell a source it is also known by this identifier, so a later capture under it lands here.

errors.name: AddAliasSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

errors.name: AddAliasUnnamespacedError
errors.description: An alias must carry the system it came from, as system:value.

errors.name: AliasAlreadyClaimedError
errors.description: Another source already answers to that identifier. An identifier belongs to at most one source; if these are the same object, merge them instead.

operations.name: REMOVE_ALIAS
operations.description: Take back an identifier that turned out to belong to something else. The canonical externalId cannot be removed this way.
operations.template: Take back an identifier that turned out to belong to something else. The canonical externalId cannot be removed this way.

errors.name: RemoveAliasSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

errors.name: CannotRemoveCanonicalIdentifierError
errors.description: That is the source's canonical externalId, not an alias. Removing it would leave the source unaddressable by the system it came from.

errors.name: AliasNotFoundError
errors.description: This source does not answer to that identifier.

operations.name: MERGE_SOURCES
operations.description: Fold sources into one because they are the same object. The losers are discarded carrying a pointer to the winner, and keep their own payloads and attachments — only the identity moves.
operations.template: Fold sources into one because they are the same object. The losers are discarded carrying a pointer to the winner, and keep their own payloads and attachments — only the identity moves.

errors.name: MergeKeepNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with the id given as the one to keep.

errors.name: MergeSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: One of the sources to fold in does not exist.

errors.name: CannotMergeSourceIntoItselfError
errors.description: A source cannot be folded into itself.

errors.name: MergeAlreadyMergedError
errors.description: That source has already been folded into another one. Split it first if it was folded into the wrong place.

operations.name: SPLIT_SOURCE
operations.description: Undo a merge that was wrong. Restores the source and takes back from the winner exactly the identifiers this source still carries.
operations.template: Undo a merge that was wrong. Restores the source and takes back from the winner exactly the identifiers this source still carries.

errors.name: SplitSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

errors.name: SourceNotMergedError
errors.description: That source stands on its own, so there is no merge to undo.

modules.name: classify
modules.description: Saying what something is. Additive and reversible; none of it touches the payload.

operations.name: SET_SOURCE_TITLE
operations.description: Title a source, when what it arrived with is unhelpful.
operations.template: Title a source, when what it arrived with is unhelpful.

errors.name: SetSourceTitleNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

operations.name: TAG_SOURCE
operations.description: Add tags. Tags are a set, so tagging twice is not an error.
operations.template: Add tags. Tags are a set, so tagging twice is not an error.

errors.name: TagSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

operations.name: UNTAG_SOURCE
operations.description: Remove tags. Removing one that is not there is not an error.
operations.template: Remove tags. Removing one that is not there is not an error.

errors.name: UntagSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

operations.name: SET_SOURCE_STATUS
operations.description: Move a source through NEW, PROCESSING and COMPLETED, or discard it.
operations.template: Move a source through NEW, PROCESSING and COMPLETED, or discard it.

errors.name: SetSourceStatusNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

errors.name: CannotRestatusMergedSourceError
errors.description: That source has been folded into another, so its status records the merge. Split it first if it should stand on its own again.

operations.name: DISCARD_SOURCE
operations.description: Ignore this one. A convenience for SET_SOURCE_STATUS, so the common decision is one obvious call.
operations.template: Ignore this one. A convenience for SET_SOURCE_STATUS, so the common decision is one obvious call.

errors.name: DiscardSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: There is no source with that id.

modules.name: tasks
modules.description: Work a person still has to do about a source, or about the batch.

operations.name: CREATE_TASK
operations.description: Raise work for a person. Attach it to a source, or leave it about the batch.
operations.schema:
input CreateTaskInput {
    id: OID!
    description: String
    owner: String
    source: OID
    status: ProcessingTaskStatus
    createdAt: DateTime!
}
operations.template: Raise work for a person. Attach it to a source, or leave it about the batch.

errors.name: TaskIdTakenError
errors.description: A task with that id already exists.

errors.name: TaskSourceNotFoundError
errors.description: The task points at a source that does not exist. Leave it out to raise a task about the whole batch.

operations.name: SET_TASK_STATUS
operations.description: Move a task along, or cancel it. There is no delete: a cancelled task records that someone decided not to do it.
